worldcombat.skill.coaching.summary: Coaches a chosen ally, raising their Attack and Defense and passing the lesson on to allies close to that ally. It must target a friend. Every stage is taken back when the window ends.
worldcombat.skill.coaching.use.0: Pad an ally's Attack and Defense before they go in
worldcombat.skill.coaching.use.1: Make a brawling ally hit harder and hold steadier
worldcombat.skill.coaching.use.2: Turn the ally guarding a doorway into a wall
worldcombat.skill.coaching.description.0: Coaching raises the target's Attack by %1$s stages and Defense by %2$s stages, lasting about %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.coaching.description.1: Allies within %1$s blocks of the coached companion learn too; the coach must get within %2$s blocks to pick a companion, and can only pick a friendly one, never itself.
worldcombat.skill.coaching.drill.intense: Intense lesson: it lasts longer but the lesson spreads less and the cooldown is longer.
worldcombat.skill.coaching.drill.quick: Quick order: it spreads wider and fires sooner, but the lesson is shorter.
worldcombat.skill.coaching.timing: Ally-targeted move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.coaching.preference.dr: Intense lesson: duration x1.4, lesson radius x0.75, telegraph +3, cooldown x1.15. Quick order: radius x1.25, telegraph -2, cooldown x0.85, duration x0.75. Each has its own opening.
worldcombat.skill.coaching.preference.ai: Both the threat and the ally must be within this distance to coach; larger runs farther to teach.
Engaged: coach the ally already fighting the threat first; Injured: only look after allies whose health has dropped.
When on, the companion will leave its post to coach an ally even under a hold order.
worldcombat.skill.coaching.description.r: While the lesson lasts, the Attack and Defense stay raised; when the window ends or is cut short, the stages actually gained are taken back. Anyone already carrying the lesson cannot be taught again.
